title: Action executor + safety policy (allowlist, payment block, redaction)
acceptance: packages/runner/src/safety/policy.ts: checkAction(action, context) → 'allow' | { block: 'safety_violation', reason } | { block: 'payment_blocked' }
Domain allowlist enforced (parses observation.origin for outside-allowlist redirect)
Block payment submission: pattern-match on aria-label/text/selector for 결제 확정 / pay / submit-payment
Block destructive selectors (delete account, irreversible actions)
Redact: AgentTypeAction with text matching CC/CVV patterns is masked before being logged
Tests: each policy branch (allowlist hit, payment block, destructive block, redaction) has a unit test
